title: Warm German Pastrami Panini
description: A simple and delicious panini recipe featuring thinly sliced pastrami, served with a side of spicy mustard.
instructions: Preheat a panini press or grill to medium-high heat.
Butter or spray one side of each bread slice.
Place one slice of bread, butter-side down, in the panini press.
Top with a slice of pastrami, a slice of cheese, and another slice of bread, butter-side up.
Cook for 3-4 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Repeat with the remaining bread slices and filling ingredients.
Serve immediately with spicy mustard on the side.
